name: angiotensin ii
uses: 1. INDICATIONS AND USAGE GIAPREZA increases blood pressure in adults with septic or other distributive shock [see Clinical Studies (14)] . GIAPREZA is a vasoconstrictor to increase blood pressure in adults with septic or other distributive shock. ( 1 )
pediatric: 8.4. Pediatric Use The safety and efficacy of GIAPREZA in pediatric patients have not been established.
interactions: 7. DRUG INTERACTIONS Angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors ACE inhibitors may increase response to GIAPREZA. ( 7.1 ) Angiotensin II Receptor Blockers (ARB) ARBs may reduce response to GIAPREZA. ( 7.2 ) 7.1. Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors Concomitant use of angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors may increase the response to GIAPREZA. 7.2. Angiotensin II Receptor Blockers (ARB) Concomitant use of angiotensin II receptor blockers (ARBs) may decrease the response to GIAPREZA.
